messages:
olivia: Quick proposal: 'Trial Reserve' to let small customers try reserved pools (90d, capped burst) without year-long contract. Need GA criteria and scope.

sam: Implementation: per-tenant token bucket + low-priority admission. Exceed -> fallback to hosted.

priya: Ops: require occupancy fallback at 80% and alerting for noisy trials.

jordan: Sales: pilots help closes. Want simple terms and a conversion path.

mike: CS: customers care about p95 latency; we'll own pilot onboarding.

anya: UX copy draft: "Trial Reserve: 90 days, default 50k tokens/day, bursts up to 1.5x for 5m windows. Auto-expire."

olivia: GA checklist: Console/API onboarding, quota enforcement, observability labels, safety fallback, p95 regression guard. Timeline estimate ~8w with pilot overrides.

sam: I'll scope epics and add a 2d spike for admission policy.
